scientific_object: occurrence-conditioned survey decision procedure; not occupancy or suitability probability

architecture.1_domain_gate: training-only applicability gate; terrestrial policy only when candidate-land support is established
architecture.2_ecological_support: NDVI-state nearest-prototype support used only as an eligibility mask
architecture.4_set_selection: greedy exact sparse maximum newly covered candidate-land cells
architecture.5_operational_output: survey-site set under externally supplied budget; route/patch remains downstream operational representation

training_representation.distance_support: single nearest training prototype after robust median/IQR scaling
training_representation.ndvi_source: ESA WorldCover annual Sentinel-2 NDVI composite 2021 v200

K5.policy: q10 ecological eligibility then maximum geographic coverage

K10_or_more.policy: pure maximum geographic coverage in current development evidence
K10_or_more.claim_scope: K10,K20,K40 tested; no extrapolation to arbitrary budgets

development_evidence.cohort: 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa; development only
development_evidence.K10_K20_K40: cross-taxon jackknife selected q=1.0; ecological restriction not retained

validation_boundaries.previous_outside_izu_24_pairs_may_not_be: taxon identities were inspected and motivated the domain gate

confirmation_gate.primary: K5 frozen method vs q=1 strong geographic coverage on new taxa and new islands
confirmation_gate.failure_rule: retain failure; do not retune on confirmation outcomes

fingerprint_method: sha256 canonical JSON excluding fingerprint fields
